newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Dewan Salman up 1.08 percent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Dewan Salman up 1.08 percent.

text.p: Pakistan's Dewan Salman Fiber rose 0.35 rupees, or 1.08 percent, to 32.60 on Monday after the company announced higher than expected profits for the year ended in June, dealers said.
The stock emerged as the volume leader on the Karachi bourse in early trade with a turnover of some 9.42 million shares.
Dealer Hina Akhlaq said the company had announced a 10 percent cash dividend for its shares holders. "The company has declared a profit of 163.6 million rupees, which is higher than expectations."
